title: ZoomCap: Evidence-Routed Visual Zooming for Recoverable Visual Information Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2610.21320v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Detailed captions transfer visual information into vision-language model supervision, but quality is easily conflated with length: long single-pass outputs still miss small objects, text, and spatial relations or promote uncertain observations into confident claims. We formulate fine-grained captioning as recoverable visual information transfer, in which a teacher acquires missing evidence under a finite observation budget and converts it into reusable supervision. ZoomCap uses a draft caption to route conditional knowledge retrieval, OCR-sensitive reading, coverage-gap recovery, and adaptive visual zooming, allocating deeper crops only to the most complex eligible region, deriving spatial relations from grounded geometry, and fusing non-duplicate evidence. We also introduce FactCycle, which scores caption-derived atomic claims on two blind anchors--source image (truthfulness) and reconstruction (realizability)--separating fabrication

translated_title: ZoomCap：面向可恢复视觉信息传递的证据路由式视觉缩放
translated_abstract: 详细描述（caption）能够将视觉信息传递到视觉-语言模型的监督信号中，但描述质量很容易与长度相混淆：单次生成的长文本输出仍然会遗漏小物体、文字内容和空间关系，或者将不确定的观察提升为自信的断言。我们将细粒度描述任务形式化为“可恢复的视觉信息传递”，即教师模型在有限的观察预算下获取缺失的证据，并将其转化为可复用的监督信号。ZoomCap 利用草稿描述来路由条件知识检索、OCR 敏感阅读、覆盖缺口恢复和自适应视觉缩放，仅将更深层的裁剪分配给最复杂的合格区域，从有依据的几何关系中推导空间关系，并融合非重复的证据。我们还提出了 FactCycle，它在两个盲锚点——源图像（真实性）和重建图像（可实现性）——上对由描述导出的原子化声明进行评分，从而区分捏造的内容
tldr: 该论文提出 ZoomCap，通过草稿描述路由证据获取与自适应视觉缩放，在有限观察预算下恢复被遗漏的细粒度视觉信息，并引入 FactCycle 基于源图像与重建图像双盲锚点评估原子化声明以过滤捏造内容，从而生成更高质量、可复用的细粒度描述监督数据。
en_tdlr: ZoomCap routes evidence acquisition, OCR-sensitive reading, and adaptive visual zooming via a draft caption to recover missed fine-grained visual information under a finite observation budget, while FactCycle scores caption-derived atomic claims against dual blind anchors (source image truthfulness and reconstruction realizability) to separate fabrications.
